items.text: Among adults receiving systemic cancer therapy at the centre, what is the prevalence of moderate or severe financial toxicity, and how does it differ by age, income, employment and travel distance?
items.population: Adults receiving systemic cancer therapy at the regional cancer centre
items.intervention: Age, household income, employment change and travel distance (exposures)
items.outcome: Moderate or severe financial toxicity on the validated 11-item questionnaire
items.setting: Four day units of a regional cancer centre

finer: Feasible with a coordinator and interpreters in three months; interesting to leadership and supportive care; novel locally; ethical under the approved protocol; relevant to a navigation decision.
summary: One PECO question on prevalence and groups.
